listing.name: Chameleon Twist: Recompiled
listing.summary: Use a permitted Chameleon Twist player with your own supported Japanese cartridge dump.

steps.title: Keep a permitted Windows copy
steps.instruction: For an existing prepared copy you are permitted to use, select ChameleonTwistJPRecompiled.exe with its complete extracted folder as the working directory. Keep assets and all supplied libraries together. The reviewed release offers a Windows ZIP; its inherited Linux documentation does not establish a separately published native Linux player.

steps.title: Select the Japanese game on first Play
steps.instruction: Choose Play explicitly and use your own unmodified Japanese Chameleon Twist ROM in the player. It recognizes the supported game and normalizes .z64, .v64 and .n64 byte orders. A different region or modified ROM is not equivalent; no game compiler or extractor is started by Portcove.

warnings: This guide covers a copy you manage yourself. On Windows, if Chameleon Twist JP Recompiled appears in the game’s available ports, choose it for the verified v0.1 package. Both routes need the supported Japanese original.
Keep that actual location and originals recoverable before replacing anything. Registration and Play stay separate; Portcove does not adopt, back up, roll back or delete these external files.

references.title: Keep the whole profile and working copy
references.instruction: You or upstream manage runtime updates. Preserve the complete working folder and normally %LOCALAPPDATA%\ChameleonTwistRecompiled, including its imported game, saves and settings. portable.txt or a custom upstream location can instead put data in the working folder. Keep that actual location and originals recoverable before replacing anything. Registration and Play stay separate; Portcove does not adopt, back up, roll back or delete these external files.

listing.download_block_reason: Only the signed Chameleon Twist JP Recompiled route can verify the approved v0.1 Windows ZIP. Here you can register a permitted copy you already have. The upstream package includes separately authored Chiaro fonts.
